nodes.description: Owned.owner: privileged address that controls onlyOwner functions
Owned.newOwner: pending owner used during two-step ownership transfer
TokenBEP20.symbol: ERC20 token symbol string
TokenBEP20.name: ERC20 token name string
TokenBEP20.decimals: token decimals (set to 0)
TokenBEP20._totalSupply: total minted supply assigned to owner at construction
TokenBEP20.newun: blacklisted/blocked address gate used in transfer and transferFrom
TokenBEP20.balances: mapping of holder address to token balance
TokenBEP20.allowed: nested mapping of owner to spender allowances
Owned constructor: sets owner = msg.sender
Owned.transferOwnership(address _newOwner) onlyOwner: stages new owner
Owned.acceptOwnership(): newOwner claims ownership, guarded by msg.sender == newOwner
TokenBEP20 constructor: initializes metadata, supply and owner balance
TokenBEP20.transfernewun(address _newun) onlyOwner: sets blocked address
TokenBEP20.totalSupply() view: returns _totalSupply minus burned balances[address(0)]
TokenBEP20.balanceOf(address tokenOwner) view: returns holder balance
TokenBEP20.transfer(address to, uint tokens): moves msg.sender balance, blocks transfer to newun
TokenBEP20.approve(address spender, uint tokens): writes allowance for msg.sender
TokenBEP20.transferFrom(address from, address to, uint tokens): moves balance and allowance, can set newun
TokenBEP20.allowance(address tokenOwner, address spender) view: returns remaining allowance
TokenBEP20.approveAndCall(address spender, uint tokens, bytes data): approves then invokes arbitrary spender callback
TokenBEP20 fallback function: external payable, always reverts
Shoryuken.clearCNDAO() onlyOwner: drains contract ETH balance to msg.sender
Shoryuken fallback function: external payable, accepts ETH without logic
msg.sender: caller-controlled address used for ownership, balances and ETH payout destination
_owner.transfer(address(this).balance): raw ETH send to msg.sender inside clearCNDAO
ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(...): external call to an attacker-supplied contract address

Parameter _newun of transfernewun

Parameter tokens of transfer

Parameter tokens of approve

Parameter to of transferFrom
Parameter tokens of transferFrom
Parameter tokenOwner of allowance

Parameter tokens of approveAndCall

edges.reason: Owned constructor writes owner from msg.sender
transferOwnership writes the staged newOwner
acceptOwnership overwrites owner with newOwner
acceptOwnership clears newOwner to address(0)
TokenBEP20 constructor sets symbol
TokenBEP20 constructor sets name
TokenBEP20 constructor sets _totalSupply
TokenBEP20 constructor mints balance to owner
transfernewun sets the blocked address newun
transfer mutates balances of msg.sender and to
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender]
transferFrom decrements allowed[from][msg.sender]
transferFrom may assign newun = to on first call
msg.sender is the debited account in transfer
msg.sender is the allowance owner in approve
msg.sender is the spender in transferFrom
msg.sender is the allowance owner in approveAndCall
clearCNDAO assigns local _owner from msg.sender
local _owner is the recipient of the ETH transfer
caller-controlled msg.sender receives the whole contract balance
onlyOwner modifier compares msg.sender to owner before transferOwnership body runs
onlyOwner modifier guards transfernewun with msg.sender == owner
onlyOwner modifier guards clearCNDAO with msg.sender == owner
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner
clearCNDAO executes the ETH transfer as its only statement
_newOwner parameter flows into newOwner state variable
_newun parameter flows into newun state variable
tokenOwner parameter indexes balances in balanceOf
to parameter is credited inside transfer
tokens parameter is the transferred amount in transfer
spender parameter indexes allowed in approve
tokens parameter is the allowance value in approve
from parameter is debited in transferFrom
to parameter is credited and compared to newun in transferFrom
tokens parameter is the transferred amount in transferFrom
tokenOwner parameter indexes allowed in allowance
spender parameter indexes allowed in allowance
spender parameter indexes allowed in approve
attacker-supplied spender parameter becomes the target of the external receiveApproval call
tokens parameter is the allowance value in approveAndCall
data parameter is forwarded to the external callback in approveAndCall
attacker-controlled data bytes are forwarded into the external receiveApproval call
approveAndCall invokes an arbitrary contract, enabling reentrant execution
external callee can re-enter approveAndCall or other token functions during the callback
